name: Hime Ichiya
source:
Main character receives an invitation letter from an unfamiliar sender to "Secret women overnight festival" on isolated Inaba island. His sister-in-law behaves strangely after receiving the letter and soon disappears. Protagonist decides to visit this event on the island to find his sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公收到一封来自陌生寄件人的邀请函，请他前往与世隔绝的因幡岛参加“秘女一夜祭”。嫂子收到信后举止异常，不久便失踪了。为了寻找她，主人公决定前往岛上参加活动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
